meta.title: Ruru, a free app for Bose headphones
meta.description: Ruru changes the settings on your Bose headphones. It works on your computer and on your phone.
lang.label: Language
intro.p1: Ruru changes the settings on your Bose headphones. It works on your computer and on your phone.
intro.p2: It's free. You don't need an account, and it only uses the internet when you check for updates.
star.text: Ruru is open source. If you like it, please give it a star on GitHub. It helps other people find it.
demo.name: Demo QC Ultra Headphones
demo.lock: {mode} is built into the headphones and can't be changed. Choose or add one of your own modes to set these.
demo.caption: This is a working copy of the app with pretend headphones.
how.title: How it works
how.step1: Download Ruru for your computer or phone.
how.step2: Connect your headphones with Bluetooth, the way you always do.
how.step3: Open Ruru. It finds your headphones and shows their settings.
dl.title: Download
dl.intro: Pick your computer or phone. Each button gets the newest version.
dl.windows.name: Windows 10 and 11
dl.mac.name: Mac with an Apple chip, macOS 12 or newer
dl.mac.status: It opens and works in demo mode. Nobody has tried it with headphones yet.
dl.linux.name: Linux
dl.linux.status: It opens and works in demo mode. Nobody has tried it with headphones yet. The .deb file needs Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian 13, or newer.
dl.android.name: Android 9 or newer
dl.android.status: It opens and works in demo mode. Nobody has tried it on a real phone yet.
dl.ios.name: iPhone with iOS 16 or newer
dl.ios.status: You need a sideloading tool to install it. Nobody has tried it on a real iPhone yet, so it might not work.
dl.after: Every version has a demo mode with pretend headphones, so you can look around first.
first.title: Opening it the first time
first.p1: Windows and Mac may warn you the first time, because Ruru isn't signed by Microsoft or Apple yet.
first.item1: On Windows, choose More info, then Run anyway.
first.item2: On a Mac, open System Settings, then Privacy & Security, and choose Open Anyway. On macOS 12 it's System Preferences, then Security & Privacy.
first.p2: If Windows says Smart App Control blocked Ruru, Ruru can't run on that computer. Smart App Control only allows signed apps.
first.p3: Close the Bose app first. Only one app can talk to the headphones at a time.
feat.title: Features
feat.a1: Listening modes, and your own modes
feat.a6: Self voice, multipoint, auto-off and auto play/pause
feat.b1: Works on Windows, Mac, Linux, Android and iPhone
feat.b2: Battery level by the clock on a computer
feat.b3: A desktop window with a sidebar and its own title bar on Windows
feat.b4: One-click updates that download and check the new version, then ask before installing (Windows and Mac)
feat.b5: Opens in about a second on Windows
feat.b8: Free and open source, MIT licence
desk.title: Desktop app
desk.p1: On a computer, Ruru is a window with a sidebar for your headphones and the battery, and two pages for sound and settings. On Windows the window has its own title bar.
desk.alt: The Ruru desktop app showing listening modes, noise cancelling and the equaliser, with pretend headphones.
desk.caption: The sound page in demo mode, with pretend headphones.
can.p2: Ruru doesn't update the headphones' firmware. Use the Bose app for that.
cmp.title: Ruru and the Bose app
cmp.worksOn.ruru: Windows, Mac, Linux, Android and iPhone
cmp.price.ruru: Free, and the code is open
cmp.after: Other free Bose tools each run on one or two of these systems.
hp.title: Headphones
hp.tested: Ruru has been tested with QC Ultra Headphones (1st Gen).
hp.should: These should work too, but nobody has tried them with Ruru yet.
hp.item4: QC SC, QC45 and QC SE
hp.item5: QC Earbuds II and QC Earbuds (2020)
hp.report: Tried Ruru with one of these? Tell me on GitHub. Use the Headphones report form, and paste the report from the bottom of the app.
priv.title: Privacy
priv.p1: Ruru talks to your headphones. It uses the internet only when you click Check for updates: then it asks GitHub for the newest version and downloads it.
priv.p2: There's no account, no tracking and no crash reports. The Android app can't use the internet at all.
priv.p3: This website has no cookies and no tracking. It asks GitHub which version is the newest.
support.title: Support
support.p1: Ruru is free. If you like it, you can buy me a coffee on Ko-fi.
